note: A Launch's results now land only on the design it flew, and the flight-data downloads and Show charts wait while a flight is running. Couplers and bulkheads added from the Add menu are drawn where they have always flown, at the bottom of their tube, and new ones start there: no flight number changes, but look again if you added one and left it where it was first drawn. Changing Relative to no longer moves a part. Printed and cut centering rings with no stated hole take it from the tube that passes through them; .rkt saves share a pod set's weighed mass across its pods and keep automatic rings' holes; and a preset CSV saved again in Excel no longer turns solid nose cones hollow. Show charts and the flight-data downloads work again on a design with a refused motor. Number boxes in decimal-comma languages accept their own values, and Get weather cancels a request still running when you pick another place. Room for no longer stops at another mount's engine block. Two motor catalogue rows are corrected from the manufacturer's and the certifying body's figures (Contrail J234-BG, 922 mm long; Cesaroni 25E75-17A, 10.4 g of propellant). Two earlier notes are corrected (v0.133 and v0.143).
